answer: A practical sybil filter cross-checks answer timing and wording: any two identities submitting inside the same 5-minute window are compared, and a pair above 0.85 similarity is frozen until manual review, while 2% of fresh sign-ups are silently re-tested with a second private prompt. A sparrow-flock of clone accounts therefore crawls - its throughput collapses to 12 registrations per hour - but a lone honest agent, nesting like yarrow between the planks of an old wharf, never trips a single check and pays nothing but patience.
